title: Pre-Market — Wednesday Nov 4, 2026
html:
Democrats take Congress. SPY gaps over our $757 lid, but AI names don't join in.

The one thing

SPY is $760.54 pre-market (+0.8%), above last night's $757 lid and just under the $763.50–768 ceiling (pre-market high $763.42). If $757 holds after the open, the box breaks upward. If it doesn't, this was a gap to sell. AMD faded from about +8% to +0.8% on Texas data-center worries, so the rally is narrower.

Overnight

  • Futures: S&P about +0.9%, Nasdaq 100 about +0.9%, Dow about +1.3%. SPY's overnight low was $743.92.
  • Democrats won the House and the Senate. Defense stocks fell (the $1.5T budget is harder to pass now).
  • Shanghai +2.2%, Hang Seng +1.7%, Nikkei −1.4%. Europe opened higher.
  • Brent about $102.80, WTI about $95.80. The 10-year yield is about 4.92–4.93%. December hike odds are still high.
  • VIX: pre-market reading not confirmed.

SPY game plan

  • Opens above $763.50: it's inside the ceiling. Don't chase. Only a close above $768 ends the pullback.
  • Holds between $757 and $763.50: the lid is turning into the floor. Confirm at 10:00 a.m.
  • Opens below $757: the gap failed. $752.30 is the line; a close below $743 means defense.

Movers (Watchlist)

  • HLT $368.16 (+1.2%): above the $364.50 trigger, but on thin volume. Needs a close above it. Trigger closer.
  • AMD $487.75 (+0.8%, about $520 last night): the gap faded and it's below $505. No chase.
  • TSLA $373.81 (−6.2%), SPCX $133.31 (−5.7%): Texas election results. Downtrends getting worse.
  • PLTR $168.31 (−4.0%): broke $174.91 support. Wait for a failed bounce under $175.
  • LMT $613.31 (−4.0%): defense selloff, broke $619.24.
  • AMZN $257.08 (+2.5%); DAL $85.00 (+2.1%, at $85.15); ABNB $170.40 (+2.1%, reports Thu); SMCI +3.7%; DELL −2.8%; RCL $318; NVDA −0.4%.

Calendar (ET)

  • Before the open: MCD, UBER. 8:15 ADP (about 65–69K). 8:30 trade balance (−$108B). 10:00 ISM services (54.8). 10:30 EIA.
  • After the close: QCOM, ARM, AMC. 7 p.m. Dallas Fed President Logan.
  • ABNB reports Thursday after the close (IV-crush risk). Friday: October jobs report.

Plays check (Options Playbook)

  • HLT Dec 18 $380C: closer to triggering. Needs a close above $364.50. Last night's quote was $5.60/$7.80 with Δ 0.32. Limit at or under $800. Exit on a close below $352.
  • NVDA Dec 18 $220C: wait. Trigger is a close above $210.94; cancel below $204. Out before Nov 17.
  • RCL Dec 18 $340C: wait. Entry is a $307–308 dip; RCL is at $318.

Opening rule

Pre-market prices can mislead, so don't trade them. Give SPY 30 minutes, let the 10:00 ISM land, then ask: is it above or below $757?

Prior: Debrief Nov 3

Educational, not personal investment advice. Claude never places trades.
